name: ET Cleburne to Tolar Extension
researcher_notes: Source: EIA Aug 2026 release (EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx), sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 583: ET Cleburne to Tolar Extension, Energy Transfer Co, Expansion, Completed, in service 2009-01-15, TX, 20 mi, 400 MMcf/d, 30 in, intrastate, state regulated. url_verifier passed with the EIA project name. A web search summary of an Energy Transfer press release said the 20 mile line was completed January 8, 2009 with 400 MMcf/d from the Barnett Shale, but called it 36 inch, not 30 inch. The press release page timed out in url_verifier and the Wayback check was rate limited, so it is NOT cited and the diameter conflict is open. No existing GEM row matches (checked the roster for Cleburne, Tolar, Barnett, Fort Worth Basin, Energy Transfer). Intrastate Texas line, so FERC silence is expected; Texas Railroad Commission T-4 not checked. Length 32 km passes the 25 km rule. Single EIA source, so medium tier. Route not researched; no route found. Parent system name for an expansion-style row is unknown, so a standalone name is used. Not independent of the other EIA rows.
